rollups.text: Crystal Wilson’s resume and portfolio development progressed from a portfolio-ready, ATS-compatible resume goal on 2024-03-15 to tailoring for film, television, and digital media by 2024-04-10. By 2024-05-02, she had compared her resume with five job descriptions in Jobscan and improved its keyword match by 25%; she also reported using Textio to find 15 action verbs by 2024-04-30. She redesigned her Squarespace portfolio on 2024-05-01 and later integrated three storytelling metrics by 2024-07-02. She added 12 industry-specific keywords by 2024-07-06 and reported an 18% ranking improvement after updating for StreamWave’s ATS parser by 2024-09-10. She launched a portfolio website with 20 projects and detailed metrics on 2024-09-08, and by 2024-11-18 reported that resume tailoring had increased interview invitations by 25% since August and that an AI resume tool increased keyword density by 22%. Key elapsed intervals: 26 days from the March 15 resume goal to the April 10 tailoring target; 150 days from March 15 to the September 10 ranking update; 71 days from September 8 to the November 18 AI-tool report.

Crystal Wilson explored moving from traditional television production toward digital media and streaming roles by 2024-05-02, targeting opportunities such as Netflix and Hulu. On 2024-07-07 she was preparing to start a digital media executive producer role at StreamWave on 2024-08-01, with a reported salary of $98,000. She reported a promotion to Senior Executive Producer on 2024-09-01 with a 12% increase to $110,000. On 2024-11-18 she was considering a UK streaming-company opportunity and London relocation; a Zoom interview was scheduled for 2024-11-25. Elapsed intervals: 91 days from May 2 to the stated StreamWave start date; 31 days from August 1 to the reported promotion; 85 days from August 1 to the scheduled UK interview.

rollups.text: Crystal Wilson considered a UK move and a UK streaming-company role in November 2024. On 2024-11-18 she reported a $3,000 relocation budget, later described it as adjusted to $3,500 for visa processing and initial accommodation, and considered Shoreditch short-term rentals averaging £1,800 monthly for three months (£5,400 before additional costs). She was weighing a £90,000 offer and a 10% negotiation target of £99,000, while also weighing staying in Montserrat at $110,000 against a UK role paying $120,000. She had not made a relocation or job decision in the records. The November 25 interview was scheduled seven days after the November 18 planning discussion.

Ahead of her scheduled UK streaming-company Zoom interview on 2024-11-25, Crystal Wilson arranged preparation sessions with Dawn and Bryan for 2024-11-21 and 2024-11-23, both at 4:00 PM AST. She planned structured agendas covering behavioral and technical questions, resume and portfolio review, mock interviews, scenario questions, feedback, and company research. The sessions were scheduled four and two days before the interview, respectively.

Crystal Wilson reported several portfolio and professional-profile projects: a Behance portfolio containing 12 projects dated 2010–2023 (reported 2024-03-15); a Squarespace portfolio redesign completed 2024-05-01; five award-winning projects selected for her portfolio by 2024-05-02; an eco-friendly filming-practices project added 2024-06-28; three storytelling metrics—audience retention, engagement rate, and social shares—integrated by 2024-07-02; a portfolio website launched 2024-09-08 featuring 20 projects with detailed metrics; and a LinkedIn headline updated 2024-07-05 to “Executive Producer | Digital Storytelling | Caribbean Media Innovator.”

Crystal Wilson reported the following learning and professional-development milestones: she said on 2024-03-15 that she had completed 40% of a LinkedIn Learning course, but later clarified she had never enrolled in an ATS course or training program (2024-03-15; T22, T42, T48). On 2024-05-02 she reported 90% completion of an ATS optimization course by 2024-04-28 (T50); on 2024-07-07 she repeated that report (T104). She also reported completing three online digital media leadership courses with a 95% average by 2024-07-06 (T134, T136), completing an Advanced Digital Media Production certification on 2024-09-05 (T150), and enrolling in a UK employment law and resume-compliance course on 2024-11-10, reaching 50% completion by 2024-11-18 (T224). Later statements conflict with some earlier learning reports: on 2024-09-10 she said she had never completed any digital media production certifications or professional development courses (T196).

rollups.text: Crystal Wilson reported using or planning wellness activities: daily 10-minute Headspace meditation on 2024-05-02; daily 30-minute walks at Montserrat Botanical Gardens scheduled by 2024-07-07; guided breathing exercises for 15 minutes daily reported 2024-09-10; and weekly yoga classes at Montserrat Wellness Center reported 2024-11-18.

Crystal Wilson described several professional contacts and meetings: she met Dawn at a storytelling workshop in 2015; met producer Bryan at the Montserrat Film Festival in 2018; met director Alexis at the Caribbean Media Conference in 2022; collaborated with Bryan on a LinkedIn update on 2024-04-20; spoke with Alexis by Zoom on 2024-05-01; met friend Diana for lunch at The Coral Reef Restaurant on 2024-07-01; met veteran producer Nicole at an industry panel on 2024-09-03; discussed European resumes with David over coffee at The Greenhouse Café on 2024-11-15; planned to meet Alexis at The Harbour View Restaurant on 2024-11-22; and planned interview-preparation sessions with Dawn and Bryan on 2024-11-21 and 2024-11-23.

Crystal Wilson’s reported salary changed over time: $85,000 annually on 2024-03-15; a $98,000 salary for the StreamWave executive producer role reported 2024-07-07; a $12,000 raise received in August 2024; and a promotion reported 2024-09-01 with a 12% increase to $110,000. On 2024-11-18 she described weighing her $110,000 Montserrat salary against a UK role paying $120,000 and separately considering a £90,000 UK offer with a target of £99,000. These are distinct reports and currencies; the records do not explain the relationship between the $12,000 raise and the promotion increase.

Crystal Wilson reported increases in professional visibility and application outcomes: five job interviews secured between 2024-04-25 and 2024-05-01 (one record specifies three executive-producer interviews in that period); LinkedIn profile views increased 60% after a 2024-04-20 update; LinkedIn endorsements for project-management skills increased 20% from 2024-04-01 to 2024-05-02; portfolio views reached 4,500 in October 2024, 35% above August; interview invitations increased 25% since August by 2024-11-18; and LinkedIn followers increased by 150 from 2024-07-01 to 2024-09-10.

Crystal Wilson’s stated UK relocation budget increased from $3,000 on 2024-11-18 to an adjusted $3,500 for visa-processing fees and initial accommodation, a reported increase of $500. The records do not specify when the adjustment occurred beyond the November 18 discussion.
